                Albert Lortzing — Regina - Oper in drei Akten
program: Albert Lortzing: Regina – Oper in drei Akten
events.intro: Albert Lortzing's final opera 'Regina', set against the backdrop of the 1848 revolution, tells the story of two factory workers who love Regina, the factory owner's daughter, while belonging to opposing political factions. This rarely performed work was suppressed for decades due to its political content and was only performed in censored form at its 1899 premiere, long after Lortzing's death.

                Giuseppe Verdi — La Traviata - Melodramma in drei Akten
program: Giuseppe Verdi: La Traviata - Melodramma in drei Akten
events.intro: Andreas Homoki's production of Verdi's La Traviata, with libretto by Francesco Maria Piave after Alexandre Dumas's 'Die Kameliendame', performed in Italian with German surtitles. The staging is reduced to the essentials, bringing great emotions and great music to the fore.
